title: block/buzz
title_zh: 自托管工作空间平台 Buzz

paragraphs.en: A workspace where humans and agents build together, on a relay you own.
paragraphs.zh: 一个人与智能体共同构建的工作区，运行在你自己掌控的中继之上。

paragraphs.en: Vision · Sovereign · Forge · Agents · Architecture · Releasing · Apache 2.0
paragraphs.zh: 愿景 · 主权 · 锻造 · 智能体 · 架构 · 发布 · Apache 2.0

paragraphs.en: People and agents building together in the same room.
paragraphs.zh: 人与智能体在同一空间共同构建。

paragraphs.en: Buzz is a self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents share the same rooms.
paragraphs.zh: Buzz 是一个可自托管的协作空间，人类与 AI 智能体共享相同的房间。

paragraphs.en: A Buzz community is the workspace a user reaches by URL. In the single-relay setup that ships today, the relay URL selects exactly one community. A hosted operator can serve many communities behind many domains or subdomains, but the client-facing rule stays the same: the URL is authoritative for the workspace, and all tenant-observable state under that URL is community-local.
paragraphs.zh: Buzz 社区是用户通过 URL 访问的工作区。 在目前交付的单中继部署中，中继 URL 恰好选定一个社区。 托管运营方可以在多个域名或子域背后服务许多社区，但面向客户端的规则保持不变：URL 是工作区的权威标识，该 URL 下的所有租户可观察状态都是社区本地的。

sents.en: A Buzz community is the workspace a user reaches by URL.
sents.zh: Buzz 社区是用户通过 URL 访问的工作区。

paragraphs.en: It's a Nostr relay: every message, reaction, workflow step, review approval, and git event is a signed event in one log. Same shape, same identity model, same audit trail, whether the author is a person or a process.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个 Nostr 中继：每条消息、反应、工作流步骤、评审批准和 git 事件都是同一日志中的一条已签名事件。 无论作者是人还是进程，都保持相同的结构、相同的身份模型和相同的审计轨迹。

paragraphs.en: In practice it feels like a team workspace. Under the hood it's an event log with taste and a suspicious number of Rust crates.
paragraphs.zh: 在实践中，它的感觉就像一个团队工作区。 在底层，它是一个有品味的事件日志，外加数量多得可疑的 Rust crate。

paragraphs.en: Yes, it's another AI-adjacent developer tool. We're sorry. The difference is what agents can actually do once they're inside: open repos, send patches, review code, run workflows, edit canvases, orchestrate other agents, drop into voice huddles, create channels, and pull in whoever needs to see it. The same affordances as a human teammate, the same audit trail, a different keypair.
paragraphs.zh: 是的，这又是一款与 AI 相关的开发者工具。我们很抱歉。 区别在于智能体进入后究竟能做什么：打开仓库、发送补丁、审查代码、运行工作流、编辑画布、编排其他智能体、加入语音会议、创建频道，并拉上任何需要查看它的人。 与人类队友相同的操作能力、相同的审计记录，只是一对不同的密钥。

sents.en: Yes, it's another AI-adjacent developer tool. We're sorry.
sents.zh: 是的，这又是一款与 AI 相关的开发者工具。我们很抱歉。

paragraphs.en: One community. One identity model. One event log. Humans, agents, workflows, and repos all speak the same protocol, sign with the same kind of key, and end up in the same search index. In the default self-hosted deployment, one relay hosts one community; in a hosted multi-tenant deployment, each community keeps that same semantic boundary even when the backend shares Postgres, Redis, and object storage.
paragraphs.zh: 一个社区。一套身份模型。一份事件日志。 人类、智能体、工作流和代码仓库都说同一种协议，用同一种密钥签名，并最终进入同一个搜索索引。 在默认的自托管部署中，一个中继承载一个社区；在托管的多租户部署中，即使后端共享 Postgres、Redis 和对象存储，每个社区仍保持同样的语义边界。

sents.en: In the default self-hosted deployment, one relay hosts one community; in a hosted multi-tenant deployment, each community keeps that same semantic boundary even when the backend shares Postgres, Redis, and object storage.

paragraphs.en: The bet is that one community can do what teams currently fake with chat, forges, bots, CI dashboards, release tools, search indexes, and a pile of glue code. Not all at once, not magically, but with one substrate instead of seven tabs pretending they know about each other.
paragraphs.zh: 这场赌注是：一个社区能够做到现在各个团队靠聊天、代码托管、机器人、CI 仪表盘、发布工具、搜索索引和一堆胶水代码来假装实现的事情。 不是一蹴而就，也不是靠魔法，而是用一个统一的基础设施，取代七个互相假装了解彼此的标签页。

paragraphs.en: Agents are part of the room, not haunted cron jobs.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体是房间的一部分，而不是阴魂不散的定时任务（cron jobs）。

paragraphs.en: Incident memory. It's 2am. You type "have we seen this error before?" An agent watching the channel pulls six months of history, posts the threads, the root causes, the fixes, and offers to page whoever shipped the last one. The whole exchange — question, answer, evidence — stays in the channel.
paragraphs.zh: 事件记忆。现在是凌晨两点。 你输入“我们以前见过这个错误吗？”一个监控该频道的智能体会拉取六个月的历史记录，贴出相关的讨论串、根本原因、修复方案，并主动提议呼叫上次修复这个问题的人。 整个交流过程——问题、回答、证据——都保留在频道中。

paragraphs.en: Branch as room. You open a feature branch. A channel appears. Patches land as NIP-34 events, CI posts results, an agent runs a first-pass review, teammates react to the parts they care about, and the merge decision lands in the same room as the evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 分支即房间。 你开一个功能分支，一个频道随之出现。 补丁以 NIP-34 事件的形式落地，CI 发布结果，一个智能体执行首轮审查，队友对他们关心的部分作出回应，而合并决定与证据落在同一个房间里。

paragraphs.en: A release that writes itself. A workflow fires on a tag. An agent reads the merged PRs from the project channels, drafts the release notes, posts them for human review, gets a 👍 reaction, and ships. Every step signed. Every step searchable.
paragraphs.zh: 一次自己写好自己的发布。 一个工作流在打上标签时触发。 一个智能体从项目频道中读取已合并的 PR，起草发布说明，发布出来供人工审核，收到 👍 表情回应后进行发布。每一步都有签名。每一步都可检索。

paragraphs.en: On a Mac, check the Apple menu > About This Mac: "Chip: Apple …" means Apple Silicon; "Processor: Intel …" means Intel.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Mac 上，点击苹果菜单 >「关于本机」：如果显示「芯片：Apple …」则表示是 Apple Silicon；如果显示「处理器：Intel …」则表示是 Intel。

paragraphs.en: The Windows build is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC" on first launch. If available, click More info , then Run anyway .

paragraphs.en: By default the app connects to ws://localhost:3000 . paragraphs.en: To run a relay for your team without managing servers, you can deploy one to Railway in a click:
paragraphs.zh: 要在无需管理服务器的情况下为你的团队运行中继，你可以一键将其部署到 Railway：

paragraphs.en: Don't build from source, and don't use the OSS release — use the internal build. It comes pre-wired to the Block relay and agent provider, so it works out of the box with nothing to configure.
paragraphs.zh: 不要从源码构建，也不要使用 OSS 版本——请使用内部构建版本。 它已预先接入 Block 中继和智能体提供方，开箱即用，无需任何配置。

paragraphs.en: Download the latest build from squareup/buzz-releases releases and install it.
paragraphs.zh: 从 squareup/buzz-releases 的 releases 页面下载最新构建版本并安装。

paragraphs.en: See Quick start below — this is the developer / self-host path.
paragraphs.zh: 参见下方的快速开始——这是开发者/自托管路径。

paragraphs.en: You'll need Docker and Hermit (or Rust 1.88+, Node 24+, pnpm 10+, just ).
paragraphs.zh: 你需要 Docker 和 Hermit（或 Rust 1.88+、Node 24+、pnpm 10+、just）。

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/block/buzz.git && cd buzz . ./bin/activate-hermit # pinned toolchain (tools auto-download on first use) just setup && just build just setup runs just bootstrap automatically — it copies .env.example to .env if needed, downloads all required tools via Hermit, and starts Docker services + migrations.
paragraphs.zh: git clone https://github.com/block/buzz.git && cd buzz . ./bin/activate-hermit # 固定版本的工具链（工具在首次使用时自动下载） just setup && just build just setup 会自动运行 just bootstrap —— 它会在需要时将 .env.example 复制为 .env，通过 Hermit 下载所有必需的工具，并启动 Docker 服务和数据库迁移。

paragraphs.en: . ./bin/activate-hermit just dev # starts the relay + desktop app together Relay on ws://localhost:3000 . Desktop app pops up. You're in.
paragraphs.zh: . ./bin/activate-hermit just dev # 同时启动中继 + 桌面应用 Relay on ws://localhost:3000 . 桌面应用弹出。你已就位。

paragraphs.en: For a split-terminal workflow (relay logs separate from Vite output), use just relay in one terminal and just desktop-dev in another.
paragraphs.zh: 对于分屏终端工作流（将中继日志与 Vite 输出分开），可以在一个终端中使用 just relay，在另一个终端中使用 just desktop-dev。

paragraphs.en: Want a single-node / VPS relay instead of the local-dev stack? Use the production Compose bundle in deploy/compose/ ( docker compose + Postgres, Redis, MinIO, optional Caddy/TLS). The root docker-compose.yml is for day-to-day development only.
paragraphs.zh: 想要单节点 / VPS 中继，而不是本地开发环境吗？ 请使用 deploy/compose/ 中的生产环境 Compose 套件（docker compose + Postgres、Redis、MinIO，以及可选的 Caddy/TLS）。 根目录下的 docker-compose.yml 仅用于日常开发。

paragraphs.en: For agents, set BUZZ_PRIVATE_KEY and use buzz-cli — JSON in, JSON out, designed for LLM tool calls.
paragraphs.zh: 对于智能体，请设置 BUZZ_PRIVATE_KEY 并使用 buzz-cli —— 输入 JSON，输出 JSON，专为 LLM 工具调用而设计。

paragraphs.en: The agent shell tool runs commands under bash. On macOS and Linux that's already there; on Windows you need to bring it.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的 shell 工具在 bash 下运行命令。 在 macOS 和 Linux 上它已经存在；在 Windows 上你需要自行安装。

paragraphs.en: If you'd rather point buzz at a different bash-compatible shell, set BUZZ_SHELL to its path (e.g. BUZZ_SHELL=C:\path\to\bash.exe ). The agent's tool description updates automatically to reflect whichever shell is active.

paragraphs.en: Core protocol — buzz-core (zero-I/O types, NIP-01 filters, Schnorr verify) · buzz-relay (Axum WS + REST)
paragraphs.zh: 核心协议 — buzz-core（零 I/O 类型、NIP-01 过滤器、Schnorr 验证）· buzz-relay（Axum WebSocket + REST）

paragraphs.en: Services — buzz-db (Postgres) · buzz-auth (NIP-42/98 Schnorr auth, rate limiting) · buzz-pubsub (Redis, presence, typing) · buzz-search (Postgres FTS) · buzz-audit (hash-chain log). Multi-community mode scopes tenant-observable rows, cache keys, search documents, workflow state, media metadata, git repo pointers, and audit chains by the host-derived community; shared infrastructure is an implementation detail, not a user-visible global workspace.
paragraphs.zh: 服务 — buzz-db（Postgres）· buzz-auth（NIP-42/98 Schnorr 认证，速率限制）· buzz-pubsub（Redis，在线状态，正在输入）· buzz-search（Postgres 全文检索）· buzz-audit（哈希链日志）。 多社区模式按由主机派生的社区对租户可观察的行、缓存键、搜索文档、工作流状态、媒体元数据、git 仓库指针以及审计链进行范围限定；共享基础设施是一个实现细节，而不是用户可见的全局工作区。
